verdict.rationale: Browserbase documents running thousands of concurrent browser sessions and converting any URL into HTML, JSON or markdown, which supports high-volume scraping. Its webhooks remove the need to poll for status changes. However, there is no documented batch-submission or async job API for feeding in a list of thousands of URLs, so the batching and orchestration appear to be left to the user. Missing for 10: a documented batch/async bulk-URL scrape endpoint, job queuing/retry semantics for large URL lists, and independent or hands-on corroboration of scale.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can batch scrape thousands of URLs asynchronously

citations.quote: Spin up thousands of concurrent browser sessions and return answers immediately
Quickly fetch web context for your agent by converting any URL into HTML, JSON or markdown
Browserbase webhooks send an HTTP POST to an endpoint you own as soon as a subscribed event happens, so you don't have to poll the API for status changes.
